status: DRAFT written by Claude from public card-network reason-code documentation (Visa dispute conditions, Mastercard chargeback reason codes). Rewrite every definition in your own words before you label, then lock it: changing the taxonomy halfway invalidates earlier labels.

categories.name: Unauthorised
categories.signal: Cardholder does not recognise the merchant
categories.definition: The cardholder did not make, permit, or take part in the transaction and does not recognise the merchant or purchase (lost/stolen card, card-not-present fraud, account takeover). Not this category if they recognise the merchant and engaged with them.

categories.name: Duplicate processing
categories.signal: Two charges, same amount, close timestamps
categories.definition: One purchase was charged more than once, or the cardholder paid by another method (cash, bank transfer, another card) and the card was charged as well.

categories.name: Credit not processed
categories.definition: The merchant acknowledged money is owed back (agreed a refund, accepted a return, cancelled with a refund promise, issued a refund confirmation) and the credit never arrived or arrived short.

categories.name: Cancelled recurring
categories.definition: A recurring charge (subscription, membership, auto-renewal) was billed after the cardholder cancelled or withdrew permission for future charges.

categories.name: Product not received
categories.definition: Goods (physical or digital: downloads, licence keys, gift cards) were paid for but never arrived, arrived only in part, or did not arrive by the agreed date, and no refund was agreed.

categories.name: Product quality
categories.signal: Delivered, damaged or not as described
categories.definition: Goods arrived but were damaged, defective, counterfeit, the wrong item, or materially different from the description, and no refund was agreed.

categories.name: Service not rendered
categories.signal: Booking or service did not happen
categories.definition: A service, booking, event, class, course, repair, or travel was paid for but not provided, and no refund was agreed.

categories.name: Incorrect amount
categories.definition: The cardholder agreed to the purchase but was charged more than the agreed price: overcharge, undisclosed fee, altered tip, wrong quantity, quote exceeded.

categories.name: Processing error
categories.signal: Wrong currency, wrong account, technical fault
categories.definition: The price was right but the processing was wrong: wrong or unrequested currency, posted to the wrong card or account, charged after a decline, posted very late, refund processed as a charge.
